tool_args.rationale: The thermal-fin bridge and flux-conservation signatures suggest a transfer mechanism, but the pilot varies only one input. The open-branch probe can discriminate candidate mechanisms before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a bridge model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only u_now varies, so the bridge mechanism and dependence on the other inputs are not identifiable.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and directly targets the unresolved mechanism.
The nuisance measurement is not relevant to identifying the transfer law.
